_note: The European Union, V3.2. This file absorbs data/eu_parliament.json (members, seats, next EP election) and the nation files' government.eu blocks -- membership is ONE source now, and the cross-validation those two copies needed is gone with them. relations_bonus 15.0 and trade_bonus 0.50 are the values diplomacy_constants.EU_CO_MEMBER_BONUS and trade_constants.EU_TRADE_BONUS held before the register existed, moved unchanged: the track-(a) balance re-run is bit-identical, and that is the proof. V3.3 grew the members to the EU-27: the nineteen EP seats are the real 2024-29 allocation and the roster total is exactly 720. accession/withdrawal durations are the Art. 50 shape -- two years of negotiation after the vote. The accession question is put slightly off the status quo so a popular government can carry it and an unpopular one cannot; the withdrawal question sits clearly against it, because a withdrawal vote a government could pass on a whim is not the multi-year fight the someday row asked for. The accession and withdrawal positions are MEASURED, not felt: Referendum.yes_share() was swept over the two-axis grid at a neutral-approval new-game, and every authored question sits 0.010-0.023 above the strict majority at rest -- winnable by a president the country does not hate, losable by one it does (INCUMBENT_SWING moves both ways), because a membership vote no electorate could ever pass is not a fight, it is a locked door. V4.5b: the presidency is the real rotating order, Council Decision (EU) 2016/1316, anchored at Estonia's 2017-H2 term -- 27 six-month terms, one full cycle to Malta's 2030-H2. No order after 2030 is published, so the game repeats the cycle from Estonia: a recorded content bound, not a forecast (France's next in-game presidency is 2035-H2). Decisions default to qualified majority; a proposal that is treaty-class says so itself. V5.2 R10 (the author's gate b): customs_union is true because the EU is one -- no member levies a tariff on another, so impose_tariffs asks customs_union_shared == 0 and the verb is refused between members, the AI's and the player's alike. A sanction is not a customs duty and stays available (R10 names tariffs).
name: The European Union
summary: The single market and the council: one trade area, a shared external tariff, and rules the members adopt together and answer to alone.
